notes: Account: midsize BPO-tech that builds post-call QA + coaching workflows for enterprise CX teams.
Primary ask: near-real-time post-call summaries + structured QA checks and coach highlights for supervisors.
Requirements shorthand: "Generate transcript + 3-line summary within 5s of call end for queued calls; full QA report (policy flags, CSAT cues, coaching bullets) within 60s."
Peak load: ~500 concurrent live agent listeners during morning peak; daily call volume ~40k. Cost sensitive but will pay for predictable SLA.
Model preference: open models (Redwood-verified, Llama2-13B-ish) for transparency; want quantized variants for cost. Need deterministic fallback chain for spikes.
Security: must support SAML SSO, centralized audit logs, customer-managed KMS, and data residency for EU customers. Legal wants 90-day transcripts retention default; can be configured per-customer.
Integration notes: ingestion via S3 + streaming websocket; redaction pipeline precedes model call; need sample data for POC (PII removed).
Quote from CTO: 'If you can demonstrate stable p95 latency under 800 concurrent model streams and an auto-fallback that doesn't drop summaries, we'll buy.'
Sales notes: propensity to purchase Dedicated capacity or Private for large enterprise customers; Optimize product seen as useful to tune batching/quantization profiles.
POC constraints: nightingale cannot expose production audio to third-party cloud until legal ok; they provided sanitized sample corpus for initial eval.
requirements_summary: Workload type: streaming transcripts -> immediate short summary + structured QA output (policy flags, coaching bullets, QA scorecard)
Latency targets: summary ready <=5s p50, <=12s p95; QA scorecard ready <=60s p95
Throughput targets: support 500 concurrent live agents; daily throughput 30k-45k calls; burst handling to 1.5x peak
Reliability: graceful degradation with fallback smaller model or cached summaries during capacity shortage; zero-loss policy for supervisor alerts
Model & routing: prefer open/quantized model variants; require routing by region + tier; automatic fallback to lower-cost model when Dedicated capacity saturated
Observability: token-level cost per call, per-route latency, false-positive policy flag rates; traces for inference and redaction step
Compliance: per-customer data residency, retention profiles, KMS integration for keys, comprehensive audit logs
